hero.heading: Finding a home shouldn't feel like a fight.
hero.lead: Mboa connects tenants with verified landlords, offers viewings led by a certified agent and online contract signing, while providing comprehensive management of your properties and their finances.
hero.phoneAlt: Preview of the Mboa app (screenshot coming soon)

apps.heading: Three apps,
apps.highlight: one goal: housing without the hassle.
apps.description: Everyone involved in a home gets their own tool: the person searching, the person renting out, and the owner who hands over their property.
apps.mboaP1: Search by neighbourhood, with filters and a map
apps.mboaP2: Scheduled visits with a certified agent
apps.proP2: Tenant messages and applicants' Mboa Score
apps.proP4: Agent space: areas, availability, visit reports
apps.proP5: Financial Management: Invoice Tracking and Financial Report
apps.gestionFor: For owners who hand their property over to Mboa
apps.gestionP3: Monthly report and decisions to approve
apps.gestionP4: A Mboa team dedicated to your property

trust.heading: Everything that was missing
trust.highlight: to rent with peace of mind.
trust.description: Mboa brings together in one app what the market doesn't guarantee today.
trust.phoneAlt: A property page in the Mboa app (screenshot coming soon)
trust.f1Text: Owners, agencies and agents verify their identity with Mboa.
trust.f2Text: Badges on every listing so you know who you're dealing with.
trust.f3Text: A certified Mboa agent shows you the property and writes a report.
trust.f4Text: A standard contract, signed online by both parties.
trust.f5Text: A tenant reliability score that reassures landlords.
trust.f6Text: Talk to landlords directly in the app.
trust.f7Text: Real-time financial tracking and reporting tool.
trust.f8Text: Generation and tracking of invoices between parties.

roadmap.heading: Where is
roadmap.description: Mboa starts by connecting people, then goes further, step by step.
roadmap.s1Text: The Mboa app and the Mboa Pro app, in Douala and Yaoundé.
roadmap.s2Text: Hand over the management of your property to a Mboa team: rent, maintenance, monthly report.
roadmap.s3Text: Living and short-stay spaces operated by Mboa, with the same standard everywhere.

founder.quote: Mboa was born from a personal frustration. Looking for a home in Cameroon is an ordeal everyone has been through — scams, fake numbers, money handed over with no guarantee. I wanted to build what would have changed that experience. Not another app. A trust infrastructure for Cameroonian real estate.
founder.name: Yvan SIPOUFO
founder.photoAlt: Portrait of Yvan SIPOUFO, founder of Mboa (photo coming soon)

promise.text: “With Mboa, you know what you're getting before you even show up.”

values.heading: What guides
values.v1Text: Every home should feel like yours from the very first day.
values.v2Text: From the search to moving in, every step is smooth and friction-free.
values.v3Text: The same standard and the same experience, wherever Mboa is.
values.v4Text: Designed in Cameroon, for Cameroonian reality, not copied from elsewhere.
